name: omc-compact
description: oh-my-pi compaction methods: shake (move old tool output to files, no model call) and handoff (continue from a handoff document). Use `/compact shake` or `/compact handoff [focus]`.

autoMethod.title: Auto-compaction method
autoMethod.description: What runs when the context fills; shake and handoff fall back to native when they can't help

protectTokens.title: Shake: recent tokens kept
protectTokens.description: The newest part of the conversation shake never touches

minSavings.title: Shake: minimum savings
minSavings.description: Below this many tokens saved, auto shake hands over to native compaction
